{"type":"thought","data":" XRP/USDT candle from"}
{"type":"thought","data":" October 12 to 18 closes at $1.30 or lower."}

{"type":"thought","data":" to $1.30 during the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" October 12–18 window."}

{"type":"thought","data":"on October 13 was $1.3125,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" both above the $1.30"}
{"type":"thought","data":" threshold.\n\nNo Binance candle "}
{"type":"thought","data":"in the window has touched"}
{"type":"thought","data":" $1.30. The lowest seen"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so far is about $1.308"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on October 13. The "}
{"type":"thought","data":"market closes October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 18."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market prices "}
{"type":"thought","data":"a 43% chance of XRP dropping to $1.30 before October 18. The current price sits roughly 4.5–5.5% above that level, and today’s low"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is already near $1.308."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The key question is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" whether the true probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is higher or lower "}
{"type":"thought","data":"than the market’s implied"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 43%."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe October 12–18 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"window spans seven full"}
{"type":"thought","data":" days. Only about five"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and a half days remain,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with most of October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 13 already passed. The current price sits roughly 0.6–0.9% above the $1.30 threshold, so a small wick or pullback could still"}
{"type":"thought","data":" trigger the YES outcome."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nXRP has fallen roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 10% since October 5,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" dropping from about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" $1.53 to $1.37. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" RSI sits at 42 and "}

{"type":"thought","data":" Funding is slightly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" negative."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe remaining five"}

{"type":"tool_call","toolCallId":"call-14e93659-a6f2-4fc0-949a-a8bac1045f65-4","title":"run_terminal_command","kind":"execute","status":"pending","toolName":"run_terminal_command","rawInput":{"command":"python3 - << 'PY'\nimport json, urllib.request\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\n\ndef get(url):\n    with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=20) as r:\n        return json.loads(r.read().decode())\n\nticker = get(\"https://api.binance.com/api/v3/ticker/24hr?symbol=XRPUSDT\")\nprint(\"TICKER last\", ticker[\"lastPrice\"], \"high\", ticker[\"highPrice\"], \"low\", ticker[\"lowPrice\"], \"open\", ticker[\"openPrice\"], \"change%\", ticker[\"priceChangePercent\"])\n\n# window start Oct 12 2026 04:00 UTC\nstart = int(datetime(2026,10,12,4,0,tzinfo=timezone.utc).timestamp()*1000)\nnow = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp()*1000)\nprint(\"now\", datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), \"start_ms\", start)\n\n# 15m klines in chunks of 1000\ninterval_ms = 15*60*1000\ncursor = start\nlows = []\nwhile cursor < now:\n    url = f\"https://api.binance.com/api/v3/klines?symbol=XRPUSDT&interval=15m&startTime={cursor}&endTime={now}&limit=1000\"\n    data = get(url)\n    if not data:\n        break\n    for k in data:\n        # open time, open, high, low, close\n        lows.append((int(k[0]), float(k[3]), float(k[2]), float(k[4])))\n    cursor = int(data[-1][0]) + interval_ms\n    if len(data) < 1000:\n        break\n\nprint(\"candles\", len(lows))\nmin_low = min(lows, key=lambda x: x[1])\nprint(\"MIN 15m LOW\", min_low[1], \"at\", datetime.fromtimestamp(min_low[0]/1000, timezone.utc).isoformat(), \"high\", min_low[2], \"close\", min_low[3])\n# count candles with low <= 1.30, <=1.31, <=1.32, <=1.35\nfor thr in (1.30, 1.305, 1.31, 1.32, 1.33, 1.35):\n    c = sum(1 for x in lows if x[1] <= thr)\n    print(f\"15m candles low<={thr}: {c}\")\n\n# also daily\ndaily = get(\"https://api.binance.com/api/v3/klines?symbol=XRPUSDT&interval=1d&limit=21\")\nprint(\"\\nDAILY (UTC):\")\nfor k in daily:\n    ts = datetime.fromtimestamp(int(k[0])/1000, timezone.utc)\n    print(ts.date(), \"O\", k[1], \"H\", k[2], \"L\", k[3], \"C\", k[4])\n\n# book ticker\nbt = get(\"https://api.binance.com/api/v3/ticker/bookTicker?symbol=XRPUSDT\")\nprint(\"\\nBOOK\", bt)\nPY","description":"Fetch Binance XRPUSDT lows since Oct 12"},"content":[],"locations":[]}

'PY'\nimport json, urllib.request, math\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\n\ndef get(url):\n    with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=30) as r:\n        return json.loads(r.read().decode())\n\n# 1h klines last ~90 days: 90*24=2160, two requests\nend = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp()*1000)\n# binance max 1000\nallk = []\n# walk backward\ncursor_end = end\nfor _ in range(4):\n    url = f\"https://api.binance.com/api/v3/klines?symbol=XRPUSDT&interval=1h&endTime={cursor_end}&limit=1000\"\n    data = get(url)\n    if not data:\n        break\n    allk = data + allk\n    cursor_end = int(data[0][0]) - 1\n    if len(data) < 1000:\n        break\n\n# dedupe\nseen=set(); kl=[]\nfor k in allk:\n    if k[0] in seen: continue\n    seen.add(k[0]); kl.append(k)\nkl.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])\nprint(\"hourly bars\", len(kl), \"from\", datetime.fromtimestamp(kl[0][0]/1000, timezone.utc), \"to\", datetime.fromtimestamp(kl[-1][0]/1000, timezone.utc))\n\n# log returns of close\ncloses=[float(k[4]) for k in kl]\nlows=[float(k[3]) for k in kl]\nhighs=[float(k[2]) for k in kl]\nrets=[]\nfor i in range(1,len(closes)):\n    rets.append(math.log(closes[i]/closes[i-1]))\nimport statistics\ndef vol(rs):\n    if len(rs)<2: return None\n    m=statistics.mean(rs)\n    var=sum((x-m)**2 for x in rs)/(len(rs)-1)\n    return math.sqrt(var)\n\nprint(\"hourly vol all\", vol(rets), \"dailyized\", vol(rets)*math.sqrt(24))\nprint(\"hourly vol last 14d\", vol(rets[-14*24:]), \"daily\", vol(rets[-14*24:])*math.sqrt(24))\nprint(\"hourly vol last 7d\", vol(rets[-7*24:]), \"daily\", vol(rets[-7*24:])*math.sqrt(24))\nprint(\"hourly vol last 3d\", vol(rets[-3*24:]), \"daily\", vol(rets[-3*24:])*math.sqrt(24))\nprint(\"mean hourly ret 14d\", statistics.mean(rets[-14*24:]), \"daily drift\", statistics.mean(rets[-14*24:])*24)\n\nspot=closes[-1]\nbarrier=1.30\ndist=math.log(spot/barrier)\nprint(\"spot\", spot, \"log dist to 1.30\", dist, \"pct\", (spot-barrier)/spot)\n\n# empirical: from each hour in history, did low touch spot*(barrier/spot) within H hours\n# use ratio 1.30/spot\nratio = barrier/spot\nprint(\"ratio\", ratio)\n\ndef hit_rate(lookback_hours, horizon_hours, ratio, recent_only_hours=None):\n    # use bars where we have horizon ahead\n    start_i = 0\n    if recent_only_hours:\n        start_i = max(0, len(kl)-recent_only_hours-horizon_hours)\n    hits=0; n=0\n    # step every 6 hours to reduce overlap a bit, but also report every hour\n    for i in range(start_i, len(kl)-horizon_hours):\n        s=float(kl[i][4])  # close as spot\n        level=s*ratio\n        # min low over next horizon hours (not including current bar)\n        mn=min(float(kl[j][3]) for j in range(i+1, i+1+horizon_hours))\n        n+=1\n        if mn<=level:\n            hits+=1\n    return hits, n, hits/n if n else None\n\nhorizon=int(5.42*24)  # ~130 hours\nprint(\"horizon hours\", horizon)\nfor name, recent in [(\"all\", None), (\"last60d\", 60*24), (\"last30d\", 30*24), (\"last14d\", 14*24)]:\n    h,n,p=hit_rate(None, horizon, ratio, recent)\n    print(f\"hit {name}: {h}/{n} = {p:.3f}\")\n\n# also tighter horizons\nfor days in (1,2,3,4,5,5.42,6,7):\n    hzn=int(days*24)\n    h,n,p=hit_rate(None, hzn, ratio, 45*24)\n    print(f\"last45d horizon {days}d: {h}/{n}={p:.3f}\")\n\n# What if we use a smaller move matching distance from recent low regime\n# distribution of forward min drawdown over 130h in last 30d\ndds=[]\nhzn=horizon\nstart_i=max(0, len(kl)-30*24-hzn)\nfor i in range(start_i, len(kl)-hzn, 6):\n    s=float(kl[i][4])\n    mn=min(float(kl[j][3]) for j in range(i+1, i+1+hzn))\n    dds.append((mn/s - 1)*100)\ndds.sort()\nprint(\"forward max drawdown % last30d every 6h, n\", len(dds))\nif dds:\n    for q in (0.1,0.25,0.5,0.75,0.9):\n        idx=int(q*(len(dds)-1))\n        print(f\"  q{q}: {dds[idx]:.2f}%\")\n    print(\"  worst\", dds[0], \"best\", dds[-1])\n    print(\"  pct dd <= -5.06%\", sum(1 for d in dds if d<=-5.06)/len(dds))\n\n# BTC kl=[]\nfor k in allk:\n    if k[0] in seen: continue\n    seen.add(k[0]); kl.append(k)\nkl.sort(key=lambda x:int(x[0]))\n\n# conditional: trailing 24h drawup from low is 3-6% (price bounced off a nearby low)\n# then forward horizon hit of -5.06% from current close\nhorizon=130\nratio=1.30/1.37\nhits=0; n=0\nhits30=0; n30=0\n# also bucket by trailing drawdown from 24h high\nrecords=[]\nfor i in range(24, len(kl)-horizon):\n    s=float(kl[i][4])\n    trail_low=min(float(kl[j][3]) for j in range(i-24, i+1))\n    trail_high=max(float(kl[j][2]) for j in range(i-24, i+1))\n    bounce=(s/trail_low - 1)*100  # how far above 24h low\n    dd_from_high=(s/trail_high - 1)*100\n    fwd_min=min(float(kl[j][3]) for j in range(i+1, i+1+horizon))\n    hit = fwd_min <= s*ratio\n    records.append((bounce, dd_from_high, hit, s))\n\n# current situation: low was at 00:45 UTC, now 18:00, bounce from 1.3112 to 1.37 = 4.48%\n# 24h low is 1.3112, spot 1.37, bounce 4.48%. 24h high 1.3824, dd from high -0.9%\nprint(\"current bounce from 24h low %\", (1.37/1.3112-1)*100)\n\ndef summarize(pred, label):\n    xs=[r for r in records if pred(r)]\n    if not xs:\n        print(label, \"n=0\"); return\n    p=sum(1 for r in xs if r[2])/len(xs)\n    print(f\"{label}: n={len(xs)} hit={p:.3f}\")\n\nsummarize(lambda r: 3<=r[0]<=6, \"bounce 3-6% above 24h low, all hist\")\nsummarize(lambda r: 4<=r[0]<=5.5, \"bounce 4-5.5%\")\nsummarize(lambda r: 2<=r[0]<=7, \"bounce 2-7%\")\n# recent 60d only ~ last 1440 bars\nrecent=records[-1500:]\ndef summarize_r(pred, label, data):\n    xs=[r for r in data if pred(r)]\n    if not xs:\n        print(label, \"n=0\"); return\n    p=sum(1 for r in xs if r[2])/len(xs)\n    print(f\"{label}: n={len(xs)} hit={p:.3f}\")\nsummarize_r(lambda r: 3<=r[0]<=6, \"recent bounce 3-6%\", recent)\nsummarize_r(lambda r: 4<=r[0]<=5.5, \"recent bounce 4-5.5%\", recent)\nsummarize_r(lambda r: r[0]>=3 and r[1]>-3, \"bounce>=3 and within 3% of 24h high\", records)\nsummarize_r(lambda r: r[0]>=3 and r[1]>-3, \"recent bounce>=3 near high\", recent)\n\n# CPI-like: just compute unconditional again with non-overlapping every 24h to reduce autocorrelation\nh=0; n=0\nfor i in range(0, len(kl)-horizon, 24):\n    s=float(kl[i][4])\n    fwd_min=min(float(kl[j][3]) for j in range(i+1, i+1+horizon))\n    n+=1\n    if fwd_min<=s*(1.30/1.37):\n        h+=1\nprint(f\"nonoverlap 24h all: {h}/{n}={h/n:.3f}\")\nh=0; n=0\nfor i in range(len(kl)-60*24, len(kl)-horizon, 24):\n    if i<0: continue\n    s=float(kl[i][4])\n    fwd_min=min(float(kl[j][3]) for j in range(i+1, i+1+horizon))\n    n+=1\n    if fwd_min<=s*(1.30/1.37):\n        h+=1\nprint(f\"nonoverlap 24h last60d: {h}/{n}={h/n:.3f}\")\n\n# probability using lognormal of the MINIMUM is harder; \n# simple: fraction of 5-day windows in last 90d whose range low-to-start exceeds 5.06%\nprint(\"--- done ---\")\nPY\necho \"==== BET HELP ====\"\nbench bet --help\necho \"==== HISTORY YES ====\"\nbench history --outcome Yes\necho \"==== SECONDS ====\"\nbench market | python3 -c \"import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d['seconds_left'], d['prices'])\"","description":"Conditional hit rate and bet CLI details"},"content":[],"locations":[]}
